nary_nodes.label: Ukraine strikes two oil refineries in Russia
evidence: Ukraine said it has hit two oil refineries in multiple strikes deep inside Russia with patrol boats and other vessels in the Black Sea also hit.
President Volodymyr Zelensky said the Bashneft-Novoil and Slavneft-Yanos refineries were struck in the attacks aimed at limiting oil revenues Moscow "uses to finance" its war.

nary_nodes.label: Fire at Slavneft-Yanos refinery
evidence: Yaroslavl regional governor Mikhail Evraev said Slavneft-Yanos was on fire after what he called the "largest enemy drone attack".

nary_nodes.label: 93 drones shot down over Yaroslavl region
evidence: Evraev said 93 drones were shot down over Yaroslavl region overnight.

nary_nodes.label: Patrol boats and shadow fleet vessels hit in Black Sea
evidence: The Ukrainian president also said that "two military patrol boats and shadow fleet vessels were hit" in the Black Sea, referring to tankers used by Russia to illegally export sanctioned oil.

nary_nodes.label: Total blackout in Kherson
evidence: Meanwhile, Ukraine said at least 11 people were killed in Russian attacks, and the southern city of Kherson reported a total blackout.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky gave distances of refineries from Ukrainian border
evidence: Zelensky said on Thursday that the struck Bashneft-Novoil refinery in Russia's Bashkortostan republic was about 1,300km (808 miles) from the Ukrainian border, whereas Slavneft-Yanos was almost 700km (435 miles) away.

evidence: Yaroslavl regional governor Mikhail Evraev said Slavneft-Yanos was on fire after what he called the "largest enemy drone attack".
